text.p: Cinergy Corp and Trigen Energy Corp said on Monday that they have agreed to form a joint venture company that will build, own and operate cogeneration facilities and trigeneration facilities for large energy users.
Cinergy and Trigen said they will each own 50 percent of the new entity, Trigen-Cinergy Solutions LLC, and each company is prepared to invest up to $100 million in developing joint projects.
With project financing debt, the $200 million in equity can finance as much as $1 billion in projects, they said.

The companies said that joint venture, which will focus on the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Republic of Ireland, combines Cinergy's power marketing and commodity purchasing strengths with Trigen's expertise in thermal science.
The joint venture company will also provide energy and asset management services, including fuel procurement, ancillary to the joint venture company's activities.

According to Cinergy and Trigen, combining the production of thermal and electric energy can cut fuel use up to 50 percent, cut pollution by 90 percent, and save users 10 to 20 percent on their energy costs.

The companies said that construction is already underway on the development of a chilled water system to provide air conditioning for the central business district in Cincinnati and that they expect to begin initial service in April.
